Wired StudioVideoProject instance into CameraStudioView.swift. Extracted StudioMediaFilters.applySkinSmoothing to share the exact CoreImage edge-preserving skin smoothing pipeline (Gaussian blur + high-pass edge mask + CIBlendWithMask) between StudioPhotoProject and StudioVideoProject per-frame AVVideoComposition.

Wrapped all 29 raw Text literals in AuthView.swift with L10n.tr(), added @ObservedObject private var loc = LocalizationManager.shared for reactive language updates, and expanded LocalizationManager translations dictionary.
Preserved test evidence scopes and documented real backend vs fixture boundaries without exposing secrets.
